tool.name: Slow BED to Tabular converter
tool.command: ## Sleep to simulate a slow conversion - allows testing race conditions sleep 10 && cp '$input1' '$output1'
tool.help: Slow converter for testing implicit conversion caching fix (chained conversion). Sleeps for 2 seconds before converting to simulate a slow conversion. This is the second step in the chain: interval -> slow_bed -> slow_tabular
